facts.fact: The minister says 500 sites are being deployed to cover white zones with World Bank support, and 1,000 more are planned.

facts.fact: The minister says three international fibre links are completed, with Cameroon and with Sudan, for landlocked Chad; more are under study with Niger, Nigeria, Libya and the Central African Republic.
